Prepare the input maps of the STONE rockfall model from as little as a DEM: sources from the slope, friction and restitutions from a lithological map or default values.

**Toolbox folder:** Hydro-Geomorphology<br>
**Status:** Experimental<br>
**Keywords:** Rockfall, Stone, Hazard, Lithology, Sources<br>
**Class:** `org.hortonmachine.modules.StoneInputs`

**Inputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inElev` | raster file |  |  | The map of the digital elevation model (DEM), defining the grid of all the maps. |
| `inSources` | raster file |  |  | An optional existing map of sources (number of boulders per cell, -1 for stop cells). If missing, the sources are the cells steeper than pSourceSlope. |
| `pSourceSlope` | double |  | `45.0` | The slope over which a cell is a source, when no sources map is given [degrees]. |
| `pBouldersPerSource` | int |  | `1` | The number of boulders thrown from each source cell, when no sources map is given. |
| `inStopAreas` | raster file |  |  | An optional map of areas where boulders stop (e.g. lakes): its valid cells become stop cells (-1) in the sources. |
| `inLithology` | raster file |  |  | An optional map of lithological class codes, see inLithologyTable. Where (or if) it is missing, the default class is used. |
| `inLithologyTable` | CSV file |  |  | An optional CSV table of the coefficients per lithological class, with lines: code, friction, normal restitution [%], tangential restitution [%]. If missing, the 19 classes of Alvioli et al. (2021) are used, with codes 1 to 19 and 0 for unclassified. |
| `pDefaultLithology` | String |  | `Unclassified` | The class of the built-in table whose coefficients are used where the lithology is missing or its code is not in the table. Allowed values: `Unclassified`, `Anthropic deposits`, `Alluvial lacustrine marine eluvial and colluvial deposits`, `Coastal deposits`, `Landslides`, `Glacial deposits`, `Loosely packed clastic deposits`, `Consolidated clastic deposits`, `Marl`, `Carbonates-siliciclastic and marl sequence`, `Chaotic rocks and melange`, `Flysch`, `Carbonate rocks`, `Evaporites`, `Pyroclastic rocks and ignimbrites`, `Lava and basalts`, `Intrusive igneous rocks`, `Schists`, `Non-schists`, `Lakes and glaciers`. |

**Outputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outSources` | output file |  | The map of the sources: number of boulders per cell, -1 for stop cells. |
| `outNormalRestitution` | output file |  | The map of the normal restitution [%]. |
| `outTangentialRestitution` | output file |  | The map of the tangential restitution [%]. |
| `outFriction` | output file |  | The map of the rolling friction coefficient. |

**References**

- Alvioli, M., et al. (2021). Rockfall susceptibility and network-ranked susceptibility along the Italian railway. Engineering Geology, 293, 106301.
